message: This device isn't on any network. Join the command post's Wi-Fi.
detail: The browser reports it is offline (navigator.onLine is false).

message: Nothing answered. Most likely this device isn't on the same Wi-Fi as the Board laptop[[: {ssid}]]. A VPN or firewall may also be in the way.
detail: The request timed out or failed slowly. Next suspects: a VPN or web-protection app on this device, a firewall on the Board laptop, or a guest Wi-Fi that keeps devices apart.

message: Windows is treating this Wi-Fi as Public, so it blocks other devices from reaching the Board.
detail: Get-NetConnectionProfile reports NetworkCategory Public. As administrator: Set-NetConnectionProfile -InterfaceAlias '<adapter>' -NetworkCategory Private

message: Another program on this computer already answers on {port}[[ ({name})]]. The Board is using {other} instead, so give out the address printed below.
detail: The usual web port is in use. The Board falls back to {other}; every address given to a device must include it.

message: This computer's Node.js is too old. The Board needs version 24 or newer.
detail: Run node --version to see the installed version, then install the current LTS from nodejs.org.

message: RangerTrak isn't built yet. Run: npm run build
detail: The dist folder (dist\rangertrak\browser) is missing, so the Board has no viewer page to serve.

message: Most likely this browser hasn't accepted the Board's certificate yet, or the Board isn't running. Open the Board, choose Advanced, then Proceed, and come back.
detail: The request failed within a few seconds, which usually means the browser refused the Board's self-signed certificate. A browser cannot tell this from a Board that is not running.

message: This device couldn't reach {host}. Names ending in .local don't work on every network: paste the address made of numbers that the Board printed under the name. If that fails too, open the Board once to accept its certificate.
detail: A .local name is found by multicast DNS, which some routers do not pass between Wi-Fi and wired devices, and some devices do not support. The numbered address always works on the same network (E-289).

message: Your browser is blocking RangerTrak from reaching devices on this network. Allow local network access for this site in the browser's site settings.
detail: The browser's local network access permission is denied for this site. In Chrome: the padlock next to the address, Site settings, Local network access, Allow.

message: A VPN or web-protection app can block the Board. Turn it off while you use the Board.
detail: VPN apps and web-protection or ad-blocking apps can route or filter traffic to local addresses.

message: That's the viewer's address. The scribe's address is the same without /view.
detail: The address ended in /view. RangerTrak removes it automatically.

message: Something answered at that address, but it isn't a RangerTrak Board.
detail: The reply to /api/hello did not carry the RangerTrak Board signature. Check the address, or whether another program uses that address.

message: Lost the Board at {time}.[[ Still on {ssid}?]] Is the Board laptop awake?
detail: The viewer's last request to the Board failed. What is on screen is the last report received.

message: The Board is fine. The scribe's device last checked in {minutes} min ago.
detail: The scribe's RangerTrak checks in about every 30 seconds while publishing. It has been quiet longer than 2 minutes: the device may be asleep, offline or no longer publishing.

message: If your phone says No internet on this Wi-Fi, choose Stay connected.
detail: Android's switch to mobile data and iOS Wi-Fi Assist both leave a Wi-Fi network that has no internet.

message: Keep this computer plugged in with the lid open. If it sleeps, the Board stops.
detail: The Board only runs while this computer is awake. On battery, set sleep to Never while the Board is in use.
